desc: Smith & Wesson is reinventing micro-metal pistols! This new hammer fired all metal micro-compact pistol chambered in 9MM has a 3.1in barrel, is .95 wide, has a flat face trigger with integrated safety, metal white dot sights, glare reducing slide serrations, ambidextrous manual thumb safety, enhanced grip texture with two interchangeable backstraps and has a 10rd and 12rd magazine capacity!
